sentences: Almost 2-SAT asks whether a limited number of clauses can be removed from a 2-CNF formula to make it satisfiable.
The saved question asks for a deterministic polynomial kernel with the deletion budget as the intended parameter.
Preprocessing must retain the interactions responsible for inconsistency while reducing the complete instance to polynomial size.
